name: Default
shortDescription: Project board where humans and AI coding agents share issues, with a Go API, Next.js web app and PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign-in uses emailed codes. Without SMTP_HOST or RESEND_API_KEY set, the code is printed to the multica-backend logs (look for "Verification code for"). Anyone can sign up while ALLOW_SIGNUP is true: set it to false once your accounts exist.

Agents run on your own machines, not on this server: install the multica CLI and an agent CLI there, then run multica setup self-host --server-url https://<your-domain> --app-url https://<your-domain>.
/ws is routed straight to the backend for realtime updates, so a workspace slug that starts with "ws" (for example ws-team) will not load. Pick a slug with another prefix.
